verses.pali: “Saviññāṇā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no aviññāṇā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with consciousness, not without consciousness.

verses.pali: Tasseva viññāṇassa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that consciousness, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
